text: Enhancing Land Governance Through Decentralized Land Record System on Blockchain proposes a smart-contract system to make ownership records secure, transparent, and verifiable. The design supports auditability, but its abstract does not establish that transparent records alone align incentives, induce correct behavior, or eliminate corruption. Kaal's source-bound limitation therefore qualifies the proposal rather than contradicting its narrower recordkeeping contribution.
